equipment.title: Equipment

photos.title: Photos & videos

tips.angles: Front and rear three-quarter views, in daylight
tips.interior: The interior, and the dashboard showing the mileage
tips.engine: The engine bay and the tyres

problems.rejected: {{name}}: refused because of its type or size.

review.title: Review and submit
review.description: Check everything before you send it. Our team reviews every listing before it appears in search.

submitted.description: Our team checks every listing, usually in under 24 hours. It appears in search once approved.

edit.warning: Saving changes sends the listing back to review.

media.leaveNote: New files you don't confirm are discarded when you leave this page.
media.confirmed: Your new files are saved. The listing is back in review.
